business_problem: Dealroom, a global leader in data intelligence and innovation, cemented its market position as a tech-driven innovator thanks to Google Cloud's powerful AI capabilities. This pivotal partnership has helped Dealroom become a trusted reference for innovation and market analysis worldwide.
solution_summary: We started using BigQuery and from there on we also started using some AI products and all the other fancy things in Google Cloud. Dealroom's strategic collaboration with Google Cloud-beginning around 2018-2019-was motivated by the need to scale and modernize its technical infrastructure. Dealroom was operating on AWS but foresaw that Google Cloud's advanced capabilities, particularly BigQuery, offered a more powerful and flexible platform to address the increasing volume and complexity of data. The full migration from AWS to Google Cloud-completed around 2023-enabled the company's internal teams to efficiently access and analyze large volumes of complex datasets. Ensuring seamless data accessibility across diverse teams was critical for accelerating decision-making and innovation. BigQuery became the backbone of the system.
